items.title: Rare Beauty Soft Pinch Liquid Blush - viral bestseller NA
items.summary: Rare Beauty by Selena Gomez continues to dominate in NA. Soft Pinch Liquid Blush is consistently top-ranked at Sephora. Brand pivoting to story-first ambassador strategy with Gen-Z celebrity partners to sustain momentum. Price ~$23.

items.title: The Nue Co. Functional Fragrance - Ulta bestseller, fragrance wellness trend
items.summary: The Nue Co. Functional Fragrance (mood-boosting wellness scent) is projected to reach 85% of brand sales via Ulta Beauty in 2026. Wellness-fragrance crossover is booming in NA; price ~$145 for 50ml.

items.title: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream - Amazon perennial bestseller NA skincare
items.summary: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream remains top-1 or top-3 on Amazon Beauty bestseller list consistently. Dermatologist-recommended, ceramide-based moisturizer. Price ~$19.97. 80,000+ reviews at 4.8 stars. Leading skincare entry for cross-border sellers.

items.title: Influxious by Funmi Monet - PerfumeTok to Sephora Accelerate
items.summary: Nigerian-heritage fragrance Influxious launched at Sephora via Accelerate program. Built via #PerfumeTok on TikTok. Artisanal indie fragrance entering major NA retail. Represents social-commerce-to-retail pipeline.

items.title: Bloom Nutrition Super Greens + Collagen - TikTok viral wellness beauty
items.summary: Bloom Nutrition beauty-wellness products (Super Greens, Collagen Peptides) grew massively via TikTok commerce and Amazon in NA before international expansion. DTC + Amazon + TikTok Shop triple-channel. Price ~$39.99.
